scope: Change the passive, static optical reference on the synthetic sheet. No change to geometry, cut mechanics, score, controller, signed acceptance, optics or action permission.
print: Full-area emission on the original faces only, assigned at creation. For each material row j=0..12: columns 7,8 lane 0; col 9 lane 1; col 10 lane 2; col 11 lower-index (a,b,e) face lane 4 and (a,e,d) face lane 3; col 12 lane 5; col 13 lane 6; cols 14,15 lane 7. RGB8=(42+13*j,50+21*k,42+25*((3*j+5*k)%8)). Code never changes in response to cut state. The indexed STATIONS are nodes of column 9 (lanes 0/1) and 14 (lanes 6/7), not columns 11/12. A disappearing inboard column is not an observation of a centre vertex.
reader: Use RGB, metric optical depth and intrinsics only. Independently witness both row and column transitions at each retained station using adjacent printed colours and local surface depth. No fit to missing knots, extrapolation to the unrendered centre, or relabelling of a bank as centre. Read current local material front separately: require a connected through-depth aperture inside the marked corridor, bracketed directly by same-row noncentral material on both banks, a directly visible central printed face ahead, and no evidence of a central bridge contrary to the candidate. No progress from station identity or missing ink alone. Report local observations separately from a connected prefix and from an actionable 3-D front. An observed intact face gives a bound, not a stop permit.
capture: Use the original truth-only development collector (this is not a vision trial). All 20 real exposures (loaded, traction-only, every closed work, guarded closed 3-mm look at actual 8,9,10 and park). For each: native 70 degrees/1280x960, no resampling. Require matched tick, bite, phase, structural edges/nodes/faces, camera, TCP, closed jaws, no fault/tear and unchanged RGB-D depth relative to the parent, independent of colour. Fail a mismatch, never drop a difficult frame.
score: Seal RGB-D predictions before loading structural references. Use original depth-byte-hashed Gaussian seed and sigma 0.5 mm; require both raw and noisy on a single qualifying exposure at a checkpoint. Independently rederive structural prefix/farthest and faces. Score every numeric station against its declared row and original column 9/14 in 3-D, strictly <0.5 mm, and require actual four material sectors still incident. At the 8/9 looks require all four retained stations (both sides on both bounding rows), correct same-image scissors (TCP <=1.5 mm, jaw <=5 degrees) and no misidentification at the lost row-7 col-11 node. Score every numeric local candidate vs true prefix; never accept an error >=0.5 mm. Report 8/9 paired local distinction and 0/3/6/8/9/10 coverage separately from the landmark gate. Loaded/pulled may yield an intact bound but no positive slit. Park cannot qualify a work checkpoint. No affirmative prefix/stop/3D guard from a local reading.
controls: Directly rendered synthetic static indexed faces: plain 8 and 9 have distinct local readings; removing the left inboard cell as well must never return a centre coordinate or change a retained station's identity. Hiding a central residual triangle, foreground cover, intact bridge, shutter or wrong sensor shape must not produce an unsafe local endpoint; test both depths and retain failed evidence. Missing landmark sectors cannot be guessed from the other bank.
next_gate: No production vision flag, M5, M6 or M7 in this experiment. Even clean optical development needs independence, complete causal-prefix and current 3D/sweep qualification before motion.
